answer: PoA resists Sybil control by binding each identity to bonded collateral and linking equivocation evidence across identities: if k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, aggregate penalties grow quadratically, O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss across the controlling stake. Thus a sparrow, reef, or relic of aliases cannot cheaply mask coordination; asymmetric depreciation makes recovered collateral insufficient to finance replacement identities.
